case.title: Upgrade from Pro to Business
case.subject: Upgrading our plan
case.text:
Hi,

We're opening a second location next month and will have 8 staff. I think we need to move from Pro to Business. If I upgrade mid-month, do I pay the full $199 straight away or is it prorated?

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Grant Veterinary
case.why: Plan change with a pricing question; the answer (prorated, Business $199) is in the KB, so prices in the draft are grounded.

output.reply:
Hi Olivia,

Thanks for reaching out, and congratulations on the second location! Upgrades take effect immediately, and you pay a prorated amount for the rest of the billing period, so you won't be charged the full $199 up front if you upgrade mid-month. I can't give an exact figure, as the amount depends on when in the period you upgrade.

Business is $199/month and covers up to 20 staff and multiple locations, so it fits your 8 staff and second location (Pro is limited to 5 staff).

To upgrade, the account owner can go to Settings → Billing → Change plan.

Slotwise Support
